info.description: API for managing financial data, chat interactions, and scenario planning
info.title: Financial Chat System API

post.description: Process a chat message and generate AI response with financial tool calls
Execute approved financial actions from a chat session

get.description: Returns the simplified financial timeline chart with net worth projections
Returns detailed monthly snapshots with all financial items, balances, and summaries. startDate is required (DD-MM-YYYY format). If endDate is not provided, returns only items matching startDate.

targetAssetId.description: Typed target IDs (only one should be set per impact)

targetType.description: Computed field for convenience (read-only in response)

tool_call_id.description: ID of tool call this message responds to

id.description: Unique identifier for this tool call

oaUsedForHousing.description: OA amount used for housing (for accrued interest)

parentId.description: Groups versions of same logical account

growthRate.description: GrowthRate is the per-item annual growth rate (percentage)

isAccumulator.description: IsAccumulator indicates this is the designated cash account receiving net savings (cash accounts only)

itemId.description: ItemID is the stable logical identifier used for scenario matching (parent_id if present, else row id).

parentId.description: ParentID is the original/base item id when this row is a child; else same as RowID.

rowId.description: RowID is the concrete finance_* row id (for debugging/reference).

scenariosApplied.description: ScenariosApplied lists scenario IDs merged into this response (optional).

accumulatedCashEnd.description: Cash balance at end of year (after interest)

accumulatedCashStart.description: Cash balance at start of year

accumulatorAccountId.description: ID of the accumulator cash account

interestEarned.description: Interest earned this year on accumulator

sourceLiabilityId.description: Link to liability this expense pays down

AuthToken.description: JWT token for authentication (HMAC-signed with BACKEND_SHARED_SECRET). In dev mode, use GET /api/dev/token?user_id=uuid to generate one.
AuthToken.name: X-Auth-Token
